proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the cycle-fiber, bridge frontier, negative-cycle certificate, a common-law causal completion theorem, sharp ATT region, circulation endpoints, and fixed-weight finite-sample outer coverage under its proposal-specific PT-All class. The field claim collapsed because published not-yet-treated risk-set assumptions do not preserve that cycle-flow kernel; replacing PT-All produces weighted hyperedges, while the remaining external Manski benchmark would repair a corner check but cannot raise the result above subfield tier.
tldr: Announced staggered policies can make one future-treated cohort serve as an anticipatory comparison in several Callaway--Sant'Anna risk sets. Each implementation cohort is attached to one known canonical announcement-and-implementation path, and the reference path has neither event. Over the proposal-specific canonical-path class, PT--All makes the reference-path conditional means additive, preregistered edgewise level boxes bound announcement-to-implementation responses, and bounded support constrains every reference-path cohort--time mean. The admissible anticipation vectors are exactly the primitive box intersected with the fundamental-cycle equations. The resulting theory gives the minimal-face dimension, the bridge frontier for variation independence, negative-cycle endpoint certificates, and min-cost-circulation endpoints for every signed ATT aggregate. A conditional endpoint-mixture construction now proves that every bounded cycle-compatible mean vector extends to one common law of all path potential outcomes, so the affine ATT region and its circulation endpoints are causally sharp rather than conditionally sharp. Simultaneous bounded-mean bands yield finite-sample honest outer confidence sets by one joint optimization. The only transfer to the Callaway--Sant'Anna published setup is the explicit zero-anticipation rectangular-anchor reduction; no inclusion relation with Fenaroli's published class is asserted.
gap: Callaway--Sant'Anna not-yet-treated comparisons reuse future-treated cohorts, but their point-identification result moves the base period outside a known anticipation horizon. Fenaroli's August 2026 Section 4.2 fixes never-treated controls and observes that not-yet-treated comparisons require accounting for anticipation in the comparison group. Existing bounded-anticipation work therefore supplies neither the joint compatibility restrictions across reused cohort--time means nor a full-law sharpness construction for that setting.
fill: The project gives a basis-invariant cycle theorem with a minimal-face affine-dimension formula, bridge and endpoint if-and-only-if frontiers, a bounded-outcome completion polyhedron, a min-cost-transshipment endpoint formula, and finite-sample outer coverage. Its anchored zero-anticipation formula and complete rational three-cohort instance make the normalization and contraction claims directly auditable. It isolates the only nonalgebraic step as an explicit full-law completion question over all canonical regime paths rather than assuming causal attainability.
